milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because mining tasks result in items entering inventory. Player starts with 6 red_stained_glass_pane from /give, so requiring min_count=7 confirms at least one was mined from the placed structure. The Silk Touch enchanted pickaxe in the scene ensures glass panes drop as items when broken (without Silk Touch they would shatter and drop nothing).

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task — the player must navigate toward and visually identify the polished diorite structure. Target is the center of the polished diorite structure at spawn-relative (-4, 1, 4). max_distance=5 requires the player to actually walk toward it (structure is ~6 blocks from spawn), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because this is a build/place task. Checks that at least 3 polished_diorite blocks have been placed in the wall-building area near the stone brick foundation at spawn-relative z=8. The generous box (±4 XZ, +4 Y around the foundation) allows creative wall placement while keeping it in the intended area. min_count=3 is the minimum to constitute a recognizable wall segment.
